svg.title: Who does what in kitden-sdlc
svg.desc: Who does what in kitden-sdlc. You decide; a model (Claude, Luna) only reads and writes text; a bot (Lantern, Kitden Beacon, Kitden Kettle) posts and publishes, with no model. Review, on every pull request: Claude and Luna read the change, Lantern posts one comment, you fix or merge. Client watcher, every day: Claude reads what Claude Code, Codex and Cursor changed, Lantern opens an issue in Kitden, you confirm it or close it as a false alarm. Release, when you start it: you start Release prep, Claude drafts the notes and the README, Beacon opens the release pull request, you review and merge it; then Beacon tags it and publishes it, and Kettle updates Homebrew.
